about_the_game:
This is a first-person walking simulator + life simulation game with horror and thriller elements.

Story:
You are a young man gifted with the ability to sense the supernatural. To save money, you rent an unusually cheap apartment, believing you could coexist with “them” as you always have. But you soon discover that the disturbances here run far deeper—and are far more dangerous—than anything you’ve encountered before. Each sleepless night in this eerie apartment brings you closer to the truth…

Features:

Supernatural Perception: Play as a protagonist born with the ability to sense the paranormal, and close your eyes to dispel supernatural occurrences in the apartment.

Sanity System: Paranormal phenomena will steadily erode your sanity, while sudden scares could push you over the edge instantly. Learn to close your eyes at critical moments and maintain your mental state by eating and drinking.

Life Simulation: Open doors, switch on lights, eat, drink, sleep… Interact with your surroundings in detail to gradually build immersion.

Immersive Horror Atmosphere: Built with Unreal Engine 5, combining realistic lighting and high-precision modeling to create an oppressive indoor setting rich in Asian cultural elements. Paired with lifelike environmental audio, it delivers a truly immersive horror experience.

This game does not contain any puzzle elements.

[Warning: This game contains jump scares and sudden loud sounds that may cause discomfort. If you have heart disease, epilepsy, anxiety disorders, or similar conditions, please play with caution.]
